_: Street-name signs by country (streetsigns.py). countries: ISO code -> style; a country not listed has none. mount: where the sign stands (streetsigns.MOUNTS: signal_arm, a blade on the traffic signal's mast arm naming the cross street). bg / border: signmesh.COLOUR names; ink: white or black; case: upper or as_mapped; abbrev: a key of abbrev; height_m, text_m (glyph scale), width_m [min, max]. abbrev: per language, dirs (a first or trailing direction word), first (the first word), last (the last word); words matched in lower case.
